# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the current `main` branch. Historical revisions
and local runtime artifacts are not supported release channels.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do not open a public issue or include credentials, private keys, account data,
or wallet information in a report. Use a private GitHub security advisory when
the repository security settings make that option available. Otherwise, contact
the repository owner, `@Huseyin-Cicek`, through GitHub and request a private
reporting channel.

Include a minimal reproduction, affected revision, impact, and remediation
suggestion. Do not attempt to place orders, transfer assets, or access an
account while validating a report.

## Disclosure

The maintainer will acknowledge a valid report, assess impact, and coordinate
remediation before public disclosure. Fixes must preserve the repository's
`RESEARCH_ONLY` and `LIVE_ORDER_BLOCKED` safety boundaries.
